notes.title: Sumatra: Fate of Yandi - tiny update
notes.notes:
Hi all!

[b]Thank you [/b]so much for your support with Sumatra: Fate of Yandi! The launch has gone so well and we've been getting lots of lovely feedback - we are glad you are enjoying the game :)

I've just updated the game with a tiny patch that fixes an issue with a particular achievement sometimes not unlocking, as well as a couple of tiny cosmetic adjustments here and there.

Happy adventuring!

Thanks,
Shaun
[i][b]Cloak and Dagger Games[/b][/i]
